features.feature_value: Had to choose between keeping both or deleting both (couldn’t delete just one post).
features.evidence_span: only choices were to allow both posts or delete both posts
features.rationale: The participant explicitly describes how the interface forced pair-level decisions rather than post-level.

features.feature_value: Offensive content still should remain because of free speech and exposure to new ideas.
features.evidence_span: I beleive in free speech… they still should be part of the conversation
features.rationale: They justify keeping despite offense using a stated free-speech rule and the value of being exposed to opposing views.

features.feature_value: If they don’t agree with something, they get rid of both posts.
features.evidence_span: If I see something I don't agree with, I just get rid of both.
features.rationale: Their decision rule directly ties disagreement to removing the pair.

features.feature_value: Profanity or suggestions of violence led them to dismiss the posts as a pair.
features.evidence_span: Any instances of profanity, or suggestions of violence though led me to dismiss them as a pair
features.rationale: They name specific textual cues (profanity/violence) and the resulting pair-level dismissal.

features.feature_value: Outright insults weren’t compatible with healthy discussion; even if often not great, some had policy stances.
features.evidence_span: If it seemed like outright insults I didn't think it fit in with the idea of "healthy discussion"
features.rationale: They use 'healthy discussion' and specifically discount content that is insulting, while preferring substantive policy stances.

features.feature_value: Tried to ensure the two posts were mirror images and balanced.
features.evidence_span: I tried to make sure they were mirror images and balanced.
features.rationale: They describe an explicit strategy focused on comparing/ensuring balance between paired versions.

features.feature_value: Evaluated whether the posts could support a healthy conversation and reflection.
features.evidence_span: potential to a healthy conversation in which I reflected on what I would say
features.rationale: They describe the overall criterion as promoting healthy conversation and self-reflection.

features.feature_value: Removed posts that were merely accusatory without a valid point; distinction between opinion and insulting.
features.evidence_span: remove any that were just accusatory… There is a difference in stating an opinion versus being insulting.
features.rationale: They articulate a content distinction used to decide removal while referencing accusation/insult framing.
